Nora: Quick sync 1: we finalized the review window and a few procedural updates. Please read and ACK by EOD Thu 07/01 so we can lock uploads.
Ben: where's the packet living?
Nora: Drive: /drive/PeopleOps/2026_review_cycle/Packet_Managers_FINAL.pdf and Review_Template_2026.docx
Clara: any new mandatory artifacts this year?
Nora: yes two additions: 1) Evidence Log (CSV) listing 2-6 concrete items with links + dates; 2) Confidential Context flag for sensitive HR notes (see p.9 for guidance).
Ibrahim: what is Evidence Log format? csv columns?
Nora: simple CSV: "name, date, type, link, short_note" Example provided in the packet. The goal is to make evidence scannable for calibration.
Ben: managers on travel or leave: what's the skip-level flow?
Nora: if manager is away >72h, skip-level or peer manager is assigned as provisional reviewer. Provisional reviewer must add the header "Provisional reviewer note:" with sources listed. People Ops will CC the original manager if reachable.
Clara: does provisional reviewer need to collect new peer feedback or use existing docs?
Nora: use existing docs first. If more info is required, People Ops can authorize a short ~72h feedback collection window.
PeopleOpsBot: Reminder: Required forms must be uploaded by 07/15 17:00 PT. Auto-reminders at 96h, 48h, and 12h before close.
Ibrahim: what about calibration materials? decks required or optional?
Nora: optional. If you submit a deck, name it team_calibration_v1.pdf and upload to the same folder. If no deck, ensure Evidence Log + Review Template are complete.
Ben: appeals/objection timeline?
Nora: post-calibration objection window is 5 business days. Use Objection_Form.docx (single page) and People Ops will triage with Compensation Ops and calibration chairs. Final decision is by Head of People.
Clara: are we changing rating labels? don't want confusion in committees.
Nora: labels unchanged (1-5 scale) but updated definitions and examples per role on p.4-6. Notable clarity on how scope vs impact is judged.
Ibrahim: data export for calibration: which fields get redacted?
Nora: export includes reviewer notes, evidence links, recommended band. Redacted: personal contact info, salary figures, and any free-text references to protected classes. Export preview available on 07/13 on request.
Ben: can we get a daily missing-items digest for managers? that helped last year.
Nora: yes people-ops will post a daily digest at 9am starting 07/10 listing missing forms and missing evidence logs; managers also get direct DMs.
Clara: will there be manager office hours? I have a few new managers who will need help judging evidence quality.
Nora: scheduled office hours M/W 10-11am for two weeks (Zoom in packet). We'll record and post.
PeopleOpsBot: Note: New this year - Confidential Context flag will hide flagged notes from exports; people-ops must be copied when using the flag. Misuse will trigger a follow-up.
Nora: thanks all. please ACK in thread when you've reviewed materials.
Ben: ACK.
Clara: ACK.
Ibrahim: ACK.
